name: create_canvas_cards
description: Only when the user explicitly asks to create cards or implement a discussed plan, create editable native cards in this conversation's project. Discussion alone does not authorize creation. Creates a single atomic batch, never runs a workflow or generates media. Card ids are unique aliases using only ASCII letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Content uses either text or rectangular rows (no implicit header), at most 24000 characters per card. Each batch may contain at most one loop; at most four successful batches may be created in one turn. A loop automatically connects its generation body and its content row source; do not duplicate those connections. Count mode requires count and omits source; rows mode requires source and omits count. Trigger connects from signal to generation/loop signal. Content text connects to generation text. Generation image connects to generation image or trigger completion. Content is an input source only, not an output destination. Image references may only use image1, image2, etc. supplied in the current user turn. Providers and model defaults come from the application. The result is durable and contains created card ids; the user can locate or undo the batch in the chat panel.

source.description: Alias of the content card whose rows are the loop input; required for mode rows.

body.description: Aliases of generation cards controlled by this loop; row text is delivered to each body card.
